incident_date_approx: Alleged harassment beginning November 2022 and continuing over more than a year
description: NYPD Detective Jasmin Walls sued the City of New York in Manhattan Supreme Court on July 24, 2025, alleging workplace sexual harassment and retaliation. According to the complaint, Detective Carlos Zambrano, assigned as her mentor at Brooklyn's 90th Precinct while she was on the detective track, subjected her to more than a year of harassment beginning in November 2022, including groping, sexually explicit messages, indecent exposure, and threats that she would be labeled a "rat" if she reported him. The suit alleges that when Walls reported the conduct, she was smeared with rumors, referred to NYPD Psychological Services, and stripped of her gun, shield, and ID, though a department psychologist cleared her the same day. The NYPD declined to comment on the litigation, and no resolution of the case had been reported as of July 2026.
